parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim and its 'first row' is the odd-parity row (the text later refers to 'the initial portion of length d' and to 'odd levels'). For s=1, two equal columns of height T/2 satisfy the setup (at most s+1=2 columns, total T): N(t)=2 on (0,T/2) and 0 above, so the odd row accumulates 0 and never reaches d=T/3. Hence the prescribed first cut never exists, the 'initial portion of length d' is never formed, and the subsequent accounting (arrays totaling T-d, then induction) has no defined starting operation. The text nowhere adds the branch 'if the odd row total is already < d, use zero cuts' (which would be trivial and is even consistent with the note that fewer splits are allowed), and this case is reachable (Liu can mark equal pieces). Since this sweep is the only proof of lemma (i), the sole support of the upper bound, that obligation is incomplete as written.
